About this Event

YOGA ON THE GREEN!
Oakley Greens and Embra are teaming up for a FREE outdoor yoga classes on Saturdays in October at 9 AM!
Whether you’re brand new to yoga, a first-timer, or a seasoned pro, everyone is welcome. Grab your mat, bring a friend, and start your Saturday with movement, fresh air, and good vibes on the green!
When: October 24th
Time: 9:00 AM
Where: Oakley Greens
Fee: FREE to attend
Sign up and save your spot!
